column1: # Ant waist in profile (anterior left, dorsal up): measurements and indices on the Descriptron lateral-waist landmarks (17 Nov 2026):
# 1 petiole-postpetiole joint, 2 postpetiole-gaster joint, 3 postpetiole dorsal apex (farthest above 1-2), 4 postpetiole ventral-most point
# (ventral process, farthest below 1-2), 5 petiole anterior end (peduncle tip), 6 petiolar node apex (farthest above 5-1), 7 petiole ventral
# outline below 6, 8/9 anterior/posterior end of the node's dorsal face.

column4: postpetiole height across its joint axis (dorsal apex to ventral-most point)
postpetiole dorsal height above the joint axis
ventral process: how far the postpetiole bulges below the joint axis
petiole length (peduncle tip to the postpetiole joint)
petiolar node height (apex to the ventral outline below it, across the petiole axis)
petiolar node dorsal length (dorsal face, along the petiole axis)
ventral process share of postpetiole height
petiolar node length / height (< 100 = higher than long)
petiolar node height / postpetiole height (> 100 = petiole node taller)
